name: HuMo-gen
description: Explicit TLS-verification-disable fallback on the update path, then copies downloaded PHP straight over live app files. [Opus-verified: CONFIRMED-D]
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The update check has a disabled-TLS fallback, its response supplies download sources, and the installer unpacks/copies PHP files over the live tree without a package signature.
limitations: Source review is limited to the retained commit and does not establish released-artifact or current-upstream behavior.

original_evidence.text: | HuMo-gen (HuMo-genealogy) | https://github.com/HuubMons/HuMo-genealogy.git | c7f25142 / 2026-08-15 | Y | N (admin must click through "Automatic update" wizard steps 1→3) | Y (downloads a zip — from GitHub archive URL **or** a server-supplied URL — extracts it, and `copy()`s extracted PHP files directly over the live application files that execute on every request) | Primary path is https; but code contains an **explicit fallback that disables TLS verification** (`CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST=false`, `CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER=false`) used automatically whenever the earlier https attempts fail | N | none — no hash/signature check anywhere on the downloaded zip or extracted PHP files | server-supplied/unpinned (update metadata comes unauthenticated from `raw.githubusercontent.com` or `humo-gen.com`; the actual download URL for step 1 is taken from that same unauthenticated response) | `admin/include/index_check_update.php:44-48` (GitHub raw fetch), `:140-150` (SSL_VERIFYHOST/VERIFYPEER disabled fallback), `admin/update/install_update.php:170-172` (`file_put_contents`/`file_get_contents` download of GitHub archive zip, no verification), `:238` (fallback `copy()` from server URL), `:397` (`copy($update_dir[$i].../..., $create_file)` — overwrites live app file) |
